messages:
anna-partnerships: Quick sync — kicking off cloud marketplace listing for Q4. Need to iron out packaging artifact list, IAM/service role requirements, and the minimal legal attachments we need from cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP/Azure). Who can confirm the SKU + entitlements flow?

mike-legal: I can take the legal checklist. Quick Q: do we want a BYOL option for on-prem customers in the listing or just SaaS/subscription for now?

jess-product: Prefer we ship subscription first to simplify billing connector. BYOL later as a separate offer. For now SKU = 'redwood-dedicated-v1', plus optional add-ons for premium SLO.

san-engineering: For AWS/Azure marketplace we need: AMI ID (or container image path), publisher account, and an IAM role policy for the listing to access metering endpoint. For GCP: image in GCR + service account with roles/compute.instanceAdmin and metering-write.

rachel-sales: Sales ask: can the listing include a 30-day trial credit? Marketplace often supports trial entitlements — important for self-serve.

mike-legal: Trial is fine but we need a short T&Cs blurb to attach. I'll draft a 1-paragraph addendum (no new revenue terms).

marketplace-integ-bot: Reminder: submit manifest, legal attachments, and billing contract link to marketplace portal within 14 days or listing will be delayed. Docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/marketplace/onboarding

anna-partnerships: Sam — can you paste the minimal IAM policy snippet we should include in the docs for cloud ops? Will share in portal submission.

sam-engineering: Sure — minimal example for AWS role that the listing will assume to call metering endpoint: 
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["marketplace:MeterUsage","sts:AssumeRole"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

jess-product: Packaging checklist from product side: 1) bundle tarball with README, 2) sample quickstart for private deployment, 3) pricing matrix (units = vGPU-hour + token tier), 4) logo + marketing blurb.

rachel-sales: Add a note with the channel partner contact for enterprise deals (sales@redwood). Marketplace enterprise leads should route to AE queue.

mike-legal: I'll attach our standard marketplace addendum (PDF) and a short privacy note. Also confirm: are we exposing support email in listing or routing through marketplace case system?

jess-product: Expose support@redwood for initial launch, and enable marketplace case routing as fallback.

anna-partnerships: Next steps: Sam to drop AMI/container path + IAM snippet in portal; Mike to upload legal addendum; Jess to attach pricing/artifact bundle; Rachel to confirm trial parameters. I'll submit once bundle is complete. Aim to submit by EOD Wednesday. :thumbsup:

marketplace-integ-bot: Task created: marketplace-onboard-1779123456 assigned to anna-partnerships, due 3 days.

sam-engineering: Will post AMI and container URIs here by tomorrow AM.

mike-legal: Draft uploaded to https://internal.redwood/legal/marketplace-addendum-v1.pdf — please review and flag any changes.

jess-product: Uploaded package: s3://redwood-marketplace/q4-listing/artifacts-v1.tar.gz. Pricing sheet attached in the same bucket.

rachel-sales: Ok on trial credits — configured 30 days / $500 spend limit. Linking to AE routing now.

anna-partnerships: Great. Closing this thread after submission. If anything changes ping me directly or drop in #partnerships. Thanks team! :rocket:
